sn42.11:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallesuviharati uruvelakappaṃ nāma mallānaṃ nigamo.
sn42.11:1.2: atha kho gandhabhako gāmaṇī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho gandhabhako gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn42.11:1.3: sādhu me bhante bhagavā dukkhassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca desetūti.
sn42.11:1.4: ahaṃ ca te gāmaṇi atītamaddhānaṃ ārabbha dukkhassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca deseyyaṃ
sn42.11:1.5: evaṃ ahosi atītamaddhānanti. tatra te siyā kaṅkhā siyā vimati.
sn42.11:1.6: ahaṃ ca te gāmaṇi anāgatamaddhānaṃ ārabbha dukkhassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca deseyyaṃ
sn42.11:1.7: evaṃ bhavissati anāgatamaddhānanti. tatrāpi te siyā kaṅkhā siyā vimati.
sn42.11:1.8: api cāhaṃ gāmaṇi idheva nisinno ettha ca te nisinnassa dukkhassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca desessāmi
sn42.11:1.9: taṃ suṇohi sādhukaṃ manasi karohi bhāsissāmīti.
sn42.11:1.10: evaṃ bhanteti kho gandhabhako gāmaṇī bhagavato paccassosi.
sn42.11:2.2: atthi te uruvelakappe manussā yesaṃ te vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:2.3: atthi me bhante uruvelakappe manussā yesaṃ me vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:2.4: atthi pana te gāmaṇi uruvelakappe manussā yesaṃ te vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā nuppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:2.5: atthi me bhante uruvelakappe manussā yesaṃ me vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā nuppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:2.6: ko nu kho gāmaṇi hetu ko paccayo yena te ekaccānaṃ uruvelakappiyānaṃ manussānaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ
sn42.11:2.7: sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā. ko vā pana gāmaṇi hetu ko paccayo yena te ekaccānaṃ uruvelakappiyānaṃ manussānaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā nuppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti. yesaṃ me bhante uruvelakappiyānaṃ manussānaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti atthi me tesu chandarāgo.
sn42.11:2.8: yesampana me bhante uruvelakappiyānaṃ manussānaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā nuppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā natthi me tesu chandarāgoti.
sn42.11:2.9: iminā tvaṃ gāmaṇi dhammena diṭṭhena viditena akālikena pattena pariyogāḷhena atītānāgatena yaṃ nehi
sn42.11:2.10: yaṃ kho kiñci atītamaddhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajji sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ
sn42.11:2.12: yampi hi kiñci anāgatamaddhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjissati sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ
sn42.11:2.16: yaṅkiñci atītamaddhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ chando hi mūlaṃ dukkhassāti. yaṅkiñci anāgatamaddhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjissati sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ
sn42.11:2.18: atthi me bhante ciravāsī nāma kumāro bahi āvasathe paṭivasati
sn42.11:2.19: so khvāhaṃ bhante kālasseva vuṭṭhāya purisaṃ uyyojemi
sn42.11:2.21: yāvakīvañca bhante so puriso nāgacchati tassa me hoteva aññathattaṃ
sn42.11:2.22: mā hevaṃ ciravāsissa kumārassa kiñci ābādhayethāti.
sn42.11:3.2: ciravāsissa kumārassa vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:3.3: ciravāsissa me bhante kumārassa vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ kiṃ pana me nuppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:3.4: iminā kho etaṃ gāmaṇi pariyāyena veditabbaṃ
sn42.11:3.5: yaṅkiñci dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ
sn42.11:4.2: yadā te ciravāsimātā adiṭṭhā ahosi assutā ahosi te ciravāsimātuyā chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti.
sn42.11:4.4: dassanaṃ vā te gāmaṇi āgamma savanaṃ vā evaṃ te ahosi
sn42.11:4.5: ciravāsimātuyā chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti.
sn42.11:5.2: ciravāsimātuyā te vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:5.3: ciravāsimātuyā me bhante vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ kiṃ pana me nuppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:5.4: iminā kho etaṃ gāmaṇi pariyāyena veditabbaṃ
sn42.11:5.5: yaṅkiñci dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ
